configure_lp_launch_type: configure the lp_launch_type flag to set how Launchpad programs are launched
set_lp_termination_notice_secs: set the lp_termination_notice_secs flag to control termination notice timing for Launchpad nodes
enable_lp_worker_manager_v2: enable the lp_worker_manager_v2 flag to use the new WorkerManager implementation
configure_tmux_open_window: configure the tmux_open_window flag to specify a window in a new Tmux session
configure_tmux_session_name: configure the tmux_session_name flag to set the prefix for the Tmux session name
